CHAOS_HEIDEMARIE_KEYWORD_LINK.title: Link
CHAOS_HEIDEMARIE_KEYWORD_LINK.descriptio: When played directly, discard all other Link cards in your hand.

CHAOS_HEIDEMARIE_KEYWORD_RECYCLE.descrip: When this would move to the discard or Exhaust pile, return it to your hand. Remove Recycle when this triggers.
CHAOS_HEIDEMARIE_KEYWORD_REST.title: Rest
CHAOS_HEIDEMARIE_KEYWORD_REST.descriptio: When this card is discarded, play it. It cannot return from the Exhaust pile to your hand this turn.
CHAOS_HEIDEMARIE_KEYWORD_UNIQUE.title: Unique
CHAOS_HEIDEMARIE_KEYWORD_UNIQUE.descript: Only one copy of this card can be in your deck.
